## Activity

During April 2021, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 33 captures. This provides the activity total for the month and indicates the volume submitted for review at the site. The activity record is presented for operational monitoring and supports comparison with the image-quality and grading information below.

## Image quality

Of the 33 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 9.1 per cent. These results identify the images that could not be assessed and should be considered when reviewing the site’s capture process and overall reporting performance.

## Grading

There were 7 referable results in April 2021. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that the midpoint waiting time for grading was 1 day for the month.

Staff raised no new equipment faults during April 2021.
